authored.scope: Unselected physical cuts around the source south-west L, held fixed across section and mesh trials. These cuts are not an adopted reinforcement design width.

stabilityComparison.scope: Predeclared numerical stability screen for the700to500 global response and fixed physical cut integrals. It does not qualify the rigid corner, element peak, local pad, design width or reinforcement.

sectionCuts.scope: Exact integrals of the declared element recovery along authored axis-aligned cuts. Tangent is positiveY for normalX and positiveX for normalY; twisting retains the source Mxy sign. Actual gaps remain absent material. No design width, redistribution, joint resistance, anchorage or mesh convergence is inferred.
